### Stream Temperature Data Cleanup and Aggregation

```{r}
ds = read_csv("Seasonal_Temp_Loggers.csv")

dim(ds)

head(ds)
# starting with 589,645 rows 
summary(ds)

ds = ds %>% rename(
  site_id = `Site ID`,
  og_timestamp = `Timestamp (UTC-08:00)`,
  value = Value,
  unit = Unit,
  creek_name = `Creek Name`
)

unique(ds$creek_name)
unique(ds$site_id)



```


```{r}
# add a new column for each the month/day/year value

ds = ds %>% mutate(
  month = substr(og_timestamp, 1, 2),
  day = substr(og_timestamp, 4, 5),
  year = substr(og_timestamp, 7, 11),
  #date = as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-", day)),
  date = mdy(substr(og_timestamp, 1, 10))
  )  

head(ds)


```

### Dr.Gore's Stream Data
```{r}
library(xts)
gore_stream = read_csv("ds_daily.csv")
head(gore_stream)

```

```{r}
# checking NAs, Checking max and min values
summary(gore_stream)

gore_stream_clean <- gore_stream %>% drop_na(avg_do)
summary(gore_stream_clean) # dropping rows with NA for average do

# check duplicate days
mic12 = gore_stream_clean %>% filter(Location == "MIC12") 
mic3 = gore_stream_clean %>% filter(Location == "MIC3") 

sum(duplicated(mic12$date_only))
sum(duplicated(mic3$date_only))

```

```{r}

# adding month and year number as well as season
mic12_f = mic12 %>% mutate(
  year_num  = year(date_only),   
  month_num = month(date_only),
  season = case_when(
    month_num == 9 | month_num == 10 | month_num == 11 ~ "Fall",
    month_num == 12 | month_num == 1 | month_num == 2 ~ "Winter",
    month_num == 3 | month_num == 4 | month_num == 5 ~ "Spring",
    month_num == 6 | month_num == 7 | month_num == 8 ~ "Summer"
  )
)

mic3_f = mic3 %>% mutate(
  year_num  = year(date_only),   
  month_num = month(date_only),
  season = case_when(
    month_num == 9 | month_num == 10 | month_num == 11 ~ "Fall",
    month_num == 12 | month_num == 1 | month_num == 2 ~ "Winter",
    month_num == 3 | month_num == 4 | month_num == 5 ~ "Spring",
    month_num == 6 | month_num == 7 | month_num == 8 ~ "Summer"
  )
)

# filtering out dates that have inconsistent measurements (2 points)
mic12_f = mic12_f %>% filter(date_only > "2016-01-01" & date_only <= "2024-12-31")
mic3_f = mic3_f %>% filter(date_only > '2016-01-01' & date_only <= "2024-12-31")

head(mic12_f)
head(mic3_f)

# aggregate monthly median
mic12_f = mic12_f %>% group_by(year_num, month_num, season) %>% 
  summarize(
    start_date = min(date_only),
    end_date = max(date_only),
    median_temp_c = median(avg_temp)
  )

mic3_f = mic3_f %>% group_by(year_num, month_num, season) %>% 
  summarize(
    start_date = min(date_only),
    end_date = max(date_only),
    median_temp_c = median(avg_temp)
  )

write_csv(mic12_f, "mic12.csv")

write_csv(mic3_f, "mic3.csv")

```

```{r}
# temp change over time for mic12

mic12_f %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = start_date, y = median_temp_c, color = season)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  theme_minimal()

mic3_f %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = start_date, y = median_temp_c, color = season)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

mic12_f %>% group_by(year_num) %>% summarize(median_temp_c = median(median_temp_c)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year_num, y = median_temp_c)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  theme_minimal()

mic3_f %>% group_by(year_num) %>% summarize(median_temp_c = median(median_temp_c)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year_num, y = median_temp_c)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}

gore_stream_clean %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_temp, y = avg_do)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(
    x = "Average Temperature (Degrees Celcius)",
    y = "Average Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)",
    title = "Higher Stream Temperatures are Correlated with Lower Dissolved Oxygen",
    subtitle = "Average temperature compared to average dissolved oxygen \nin the Salem Mill Creek from 2014 to 2025"
  )
```

### Address Data Cleanup and Aggregation

```{r}
ds = read_csv("salem_addresses.csv")
head(ds)
summary(ds)
sum(is.na(ds$`ZIP Code`))
```

```{}
ds %>% select(OBJECTID, ID, `Full Address`, `County Name`, `ZIP Code`, `LAST_EDITED_DATE`)
write_csv(ds, "original_salem_addresses.csv")
```

```{r}
# select only relevant columns for aggregation

ds = ds %>% group_by(`ZIP Code`) %>%
  summarize(
    count_address = n()
  ) %>%
  rename(zip_code = `ZIP Code`)

ds

```

```{r}
# add zipcode population and area values from the 2024 census
zip_code = c(97301, 97302, 97303, 97304, 97305, 97306, 97317)
population = c(57574, 40799, 40659, 34879, 45083, 34383, 25966)
squared_miles = c(11.3, 23.4, 24.9, 56.8, 47.2, 32.4, 55.2)


zip_data = data.frame(
  zip_code = zip_code,
  population = population,
  squared_miles = squared_miles
)

ds = ds %>%
  left_join(zip_data)

ds = ds %>% mutate(
  address_density_mile = count_address/squared_miles
)

ds
```



```{r}
write_csv(ds, "zip_density.csv")

```

### Stream Location Data Cleanup


```{r}
# stream <- st_read("Public_Storm_Creeks_and_Rivers_4477802176423454413/Public_Storm_Creeks_and_Rivers.shp")
stream <- st_read("Public_Storm_Creeks_and_Rivers.shp")

head(stream)
st_crs(stream)
stream = st_transform(stream, 4326)

```


```{r}
stream = stream %>% select(UNITID, UNITID2, NAME, UNITTYPE, STATUS, PWGRID, GLOBALID, FLOWDIRECT, geometry)
 
st_write(stream, "creek_locations.shp")
```


```{r}
# Riparian hardwoods --> space around rivers
stream %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(color = "black") + 
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-123.18, -122.85), 
           ylim = c(44.83, 45.06),
           datum = sf::st_crs(4326)) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{}
my_points = tree data

# 1. Load your datasets
# (Assuming 'my_points' is your points dataset and 'stream' is your stream shapefile)
# Note: They MUST be in the exact same Coordinate Reference System (CRS) for this to work.

# 2. Project them to a local coordinate system (Meters or Feet)
# Avoid using EPSG:4326 (lat/lon) here, as calculating distances in degrees is highly inaccurate.
# Instead, project to a system like UTM or a local State Plane.
target_crs <- 32610  # Example UTM Zone 10N (used for the US West Coast)

points_proj <- st_transform(my_points, target_crs)
stream_proj <- st_transform(stream, target_crs)

# 3. Calculate the distance matrix
# This creates a huge table where rows are points and columns are streams
dist_matrix <- st_distance(points_proj, stream_proj)

# 4. Extract the distance to the *nearest* stream for each point
# '1' tells apply to look row-by-row (for each point) and find the minimum value
my_points$distance_to_stream <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, min)

head(my_points)
```

### Tree Canopy Cleaning

```{r}
mic3 = read_csv("C:\\Users\\Public\\510 - Capstone\\tree_canopy_data\\creekside_tree_canopy_clipped_MIC3_MIC12_table\\creekside_tree_canopy_MIC3.csv")
mic12 = read_csv("C:\\Users\\Public\\510 - Capstone\\tree_canopy_data\\creekside_tree_canopy_clipped_MIC3_MIC12_table\\creekside_tree_canopy_MIC12.csv")

mic3
mic12
```

```{r}
# Adding an object ID value (row in the dataset)
# I am unsure if pid is a unique identifier. I have hints telling me along this process that this is not a unique identifier. To play it safe, I am making my own unique identifier.

mic3 = mic3 %>% 
  mutate(
    object_id = row_number()
  )


mic12 = mic12 %>% 
  mutate(
    object_id = row_number()
  )

mic3
mic12
```


```{r}
# Removing unneccessary variables

# NOTE ASSUMPTION: TREE CANOPY VARIABLES ARE PERCENT CHANGE, URBAN TREE CANOPY ARE THE PERCENT OF CANOPY COVERAGE 

# Removing tree canopy (don't need them, not per year canopy coverage)
mic3 = mic3 %>% 
  select(-TreeCanopy, -TreeCano_1, -TreeCano_2, -GEOID, -Shape_Leng, -Impervio_1, -pid)

mic12 = mic12 %>% 
  select(-TreeCanopy, -TreeCano_1, -TreeCano_2, -GEOID, -Shape_Leng, -Impervio_1, -pid)
  

#mic3
#mic12
```


```{r}
# Converting to long format

mic3_long = mic3 %>%
  rename(
    UrbanTreeCanopy_2020 = UrbanTreeC,
    UrbanTreeCanopy_2022 = UrbanTre_1,
    UrbanTreeCanopy_2024 = UrbanTre_2,
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("UrbanTreeCanopy_"),
```
